name: receiving.review-priority
label: Inbox review priority
gate_behavior: advisory-only; never review, include or recover automatically

priority.instructions: For this native receiving page, which next attention is warranted? This page is not the whole queue when more is true. Do not infer content quality from metadata.

criteria.recover-first: An item has uncertain inclusion or needs recovery.
criteria.review-ready: Material is pending a person's review.
criteria.nothing-on-page: This page contains no actionable material.

name: workspace.recovery-suggestion
label: Workspace recovery suggestion
gate_behavior: advisory-only; never replace the workspace book or drafts

offer-recovery.instructions: Does this disclosed layout show an empty or incomplete arrangement worth offering the person a recovery check? Renderer observations are advisory; missing information is uncertainty, not proof of lost work.

criteria.true: The visible arrangement gives a concrete reason to offer a recovery check.
criteria.false: No concrete recovery concern is disclosed.

name: agent.ui
label: Questions about the current workspace
gate_behavior: advisory-only; an answer grants no action authority
